lines.zh: 我一张一合，往上浮一点。
lines.en: I pulse once and drift a little up.

lines.zh: 我的光把水道照成淡蓝。
lines.en: My glow turns the channel pale blue.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，慢得像在呼吸。
lines.en: I move slowly, at the pace of breathing.
Five of us, our light joins into one sheet.
My tentacles trail behind like threads.

lines.zh: 我漂过石柱，光在石上滑。
lines.en: I drift past a pillar; my light slides over it.

lines.zh: 下面的鱼跟着我的光走。
lines.en: The fish below follow my light.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，路会自己过来。
lines.en: I do not hurry; the way passes by itself.
I rise to five blocks and stop.
Pressure pushes me; I go with it.

lines.zh: 我在暗里画出一条光的路。
lines.en: I draw a bright road through the dark.

lines.zh: 同伴的光在我后面合上。
lines.en: My kin's light closes behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕过黑石，光晃了一下。
lines.en: I round a black stone and my light wavers.

lines.zh: 四十厘米的伞盖撑开水。
lines.en: A forty-centimetre bell parts the water.

lines.zh: 我收一收伞，沉下去半格。
lines.en: I close my bell and sink half a block.
The light moves on; I follow it.

lines.zh: 暗水里有条裂缝，我绕开。
lines.en: A crack in the dark water; I drift around.

lines.zh: 我一鼓一鼓，像在数拍子。
lines.en: I pulse and pulse, counting a beat.

lines.zh: 我停在原处，光缓缓起伏。
lines.en: I hold my place, my glow slowly swelling.
My bell loosens, then tightens.

lines.zh: 深海的黑被我撑开一小块。
lines.en: I hold back a small patch of the dark.

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，也没有急事。
lines.en: I have no bones and no errands.

lines.zh: 一条盲鱼贴着我的触手过。
lines.en: A blind fish slides past my tentacles.
My light is gentle, not hot.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有多少触手。
lines.en: I cannot count my own tentacles.

lines.zh: 地下水的冷慢慢渗进伞盖。
lines.en: Cold groundwater seeps into my bell.

lines.zh: 我在想上面有没有月亮。
lines.en: I wonder whether there is a moon up there.

lines.zh: 黑暗中有一点绿光漂过。
lines.en: A fleck of green light drifts by.

lines.zh: 我发亮，是因为有人在看。
lines.en: I glow because something is watching.
My body is almost entirely water.

lines.zh: 我垂下触手，像收起一张网。
lines.en: I lower my tentacles like furled netting.

lines.zh: 等水流把我送到该去的地方。
lines.en: I let the current carry me where it will.

lines.zh: 你的火把比我的光刺眼。
lines.en: Your torch is harsher than my glow.

lines.zh: 我照见你的脸，你眯起眼。
lines.en: I light your face; you squint.
You dive down; the water complains.

lines.zh: 我的光落在你的护甲上。
lines.en: My light lands on your armour.
You reach out; I shrink a size.
You look; I do not flee, only slow.

lines.zh: 你的影子穿过我的伞盖。
lines.en: Your shadow passes through my bell.
I light this black water for you.
You hold your breath; I never need to.
I know that bucket in your hand.
My bell is slit open.
My light flares once, hard.
I curl up, every tentacle drawn in.
Bits of my glow float in the water.
Pain runs from bell to tentacle tip.
I cannot drift; I can only sink.
Half my light goes out.
My kin gather and light me.
One blow turns me belly-up.
I am still glowing. Not scattered yet.

lines.zh: 钩子上的光在晃，很好看。
lines.en: The glimmer on the hook is pretty.
I will not bite. I have no teeth.

lines.zh: 那东西在水里转，像我同类。
lines.en: That thing spins like one of my kin.

lines.zh: 我靠近，只想知道它亮不亮。
lines.en: I come near to see if it shines.
The line has caught my tentacles.
I do not struggle; struggling tears.
It pulls me up. I allow it.
The water grows warmer above.
I turn my light on the line.

lines.zh: 我就这样被慢慢带走了。
lines.en: Slowly, I am taken away.
Who jostled my bell?

lines.zh: 你冲得太猛，把水搅翻了。
lines.en: You rush in and churn the water over.
My tentacles bunch into a knot.
I spin half a turn before steadying.
My kin's light scatters from the knock.
I bounce away lightly, not angry.
Touch me and your hand will tingle.
I hide behind the stone pillar.

lines.zh: 水又静下来，我重新亮起。
lines.en: The water stills; I glow again.
The five of us line up again.
Your light leans bluer than mine.
Let us light this channel together.
Your bell is a size wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我飘得慢，你也是，很合适。
lines.en: I drift slowly. So do you. A good match.
Just do not tangle our tentacles.
I rise; follow me.
Our light layers into one.
This black water needs two lamps.
With you near, the fish stop fearing.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的时辰留给你。
lines.en: I save my brightest hour for you.

lines.zh: 一点碎屑落进我的触手。
lines.en: A crumb lands in my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我用触手把它送进嘴里。
lines.en: I pass it to my mouth with a tentacle.
So small I barely notice.

lines.zh: 我接到一粒发亮的东西。
lines.en: I catch something that glitters.
I do not compete; taken food tastes wrong.
It glows briefly inside me.

lines.zh: 我把剩的推给旁边的鱼。
lines.en: I push the rest to the fish nearby.
The current tips it; I set it right.
One bite and my glow steadies.
I swallow slowly. No rush.
Something churns the dark water.
A shadow descends, heavy.
The fish hide behind my light.
That is no fish; the shape is wrong.
Suddenly my light feels too bright.

lines.zh: 水在震，我的触手先知道。
lines.en: The water shakes; my tentacles feel it first.
It comes toward my brightness.
I sink slowly toward the crevice.
My kin dim one by one.

lines.zh: 我把自己的光收起来了。
lines.en: I put my light away.
I watch it, my bell drawn tight.
I stay still; light invites trouble.
It circles; I turn slowly.
All my tentacles hang low.
I count the blocks between us.
I want to dim, but cannot.
It nears, and the water feels heavier.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一枚小灯。
lines.en: I shrink into a small lamp.

lines.zh: 触手碰到石壁，我往回收。
lines.en: My tentacle touches stone; I pull it in.
I let it move first, then I move.
I sweep its hand with a tentacle.
My strength is a push of water.
I bump it and lose my own shape.
My sting only numbs it briefly.
I press close and burn it a little.
After the blow I drift away fast.
My light flickers wildly with alarm.
It steps back. So do I.
Three hearts will not last long.
I wrap myself around its wrist.

lines.zh: 我在这片黑水里亮起来。
lines.en: I light up in this black water.

lines.zh: 上面五格就是世界的地面。
lines.en: Five blocks up is the world's floor.
Five lamps open their eyes at once.

lines.zh: 我的光先照到的是石顶。
lines.en: My light first finds the stone ceiling.
Jellyfish are rare in this water.

lines.zh: 我浮起来，触手还没张开。
lines.en: I rise before my tentacles unfold.
The cold makes my glow whiter.

lines.zh: 我给深海点了第一盏灯。
lines.en: I light the first lamp of the deep.

lines.zh: 我身边立刻围来两条鱼。
lines.en: Two fish gather around me at once.

lines.zh: 我在罕见的水里开始发光。
lines.en: I begin to glow in rare water.
The water boils; my bell shrivels.

lines.zh: 我从水层摔下去，摊成一团。
lines.en: I fall between water layers and splat.

lines.zh: 我被提出水面，伞盖塌了。
lines.en: Lifted from the water, my bell collapses.

lines.zh: 石顶炸落，水里全是碎石。
lines.en: The ceiling bursts; water fills with rubble.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我的光穿了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through my light.
A spell coils around me, bitter bright.
Unfed so long, my glow thins to thread.

lines.zh: 雷灌进水里，我亮成一片白。
lines.en: Lightning floods the water; I turn white.

lines.zh: 水没了，我的光悬在空里。
lines.en: Water gone, my light hangs in nothing.
